title: AWS Summit Johannesburg
heading: Kiro: The AI Teammate That Doesn’t Break Prod
body: We’ve all seen the shiny AI demos on brand-new repos using Perfect prompts. Everything works first time with no edge cases, no legacy code and definitely no Friday deployments. In reality, that’s not how most of us live.

Most of us are dealing with systems that have long history. Code written three decades ago with functions nobody wants to touch. Tests that exist mostly in spirit and production environments that really don’t appreciate experimentation.
